suggestions.title: The Lord of the Rings: The Return of the King
suggestions.description: The final battle for Middle-earth unfolds as Frodo and Sam approach Mount Doom to destroy the One Ring. Peter Jackson's epic conclusion to the trilogy swept all 11 Academy Awards including Best Picture — a monumental achievement in filmmaking with breathtaking battles, emotional depth, and Howard Shore's majestic score.

suggestions.title: Interstellar
suggestions.description: A team of astronauts travels through a wormhole in search of a new habitable planet for humanity. Christopher Nolan's visually stunning and emotionally devastating space epic combines hard science fiction with a deeply human story of love transcending time and dimensions. Features Hans Zimmer's iconic organ score.

suggestions.title: The Silence of the Lambs
suggestions.description: An FBI trainee seeks the insight of imprisoned cannibalistic serial killer Dr. Hannibal Lecter to catch another killer. Jonathan Demme's masterful psychological thriller swept the Big Five Oscars and features Anthony Hopkins' iconic, haunting performance as Lecter in only 16 minutes of screen time.
